title: A Space's leaders get a Leadership page in the console (yearly calendar and executive overview), and a Menswork website links to it with an Admin link

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07: 'I also want the Executive Overview and Yearly Calendar in an admin gated area of the website. Create an obvious Admin link in the menu for the role.'

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. The website is cached, anonymous and on another domain, so it cannot gate anything: the gated area is a Space console page, /spaces/<slug>/manage/leadership, gated like every console page (resolveSpaceManageAccess, notFound for a non-manager, a janitor previews read-only). Two tabs. Yearly calendar: the Space's own events (drafts included, through listProgramYearEventRows in lib/calendar/admin-calendar.ts, the one module the publication gate test allows to opt out) laid over the Menswork seasons and the twelve sign start days (MENSWORK_SIGNS in lib/theme/menswork.ts), from the December lead-in through December; the year is derived from today and the events (pickProgramYear), never hardcoded; chips link to each event and take only a light look from the title. A month grid from md up, a day list below. Executive overview: owner-written Markdown on spaces.preferences.programOverview, rendered by the help Markdown renderer with a contents list, edited by managers through saveProgramOverview (gated, writes only that key, refreshes the site cache). The key never rides the public profile projection (toProfileContext strips it) and only lib/spaces/leadership.ts names it. The menu row is space.leadership in SPACE_MODULES under Gather. A website wearing the Menswork skin ends its header menu and phone menu with a labelled 'Admin' link to the page's absolute app URL. AMENDED 2026-10-07 (LIVE-864, owner ruling 'Those are Admin display pages on the site'): the overview and calendar now display on the website itself at /admin/overview and /admin/calendar; the console page keeps the gate, the overview editor and two buttons that open them through a signed pass. AMENDED 2026-10-08 (LIVE-868, owner ask 'Instead of an admin button. make it a double menu with admin settings in blue'): the Admin item left the visitor menu; the admin links live in the blue admin row (components/sites/site-admin-bar.tsx) and a quiet footer link.

2026-10-10: the website header moved into components/sites/house-header.tsx (header handoff v5: one-line scrolling menu, two-row phone layout, mega panels, fade on pause). The probe reads site-chrome.tsx and house-header.tsx together; the consequence is unchanged.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const page=r('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/leadership/page.tsx');if(!/resolveSpaceManageAccess\\(/.test(page)||!/if \\(!canManage && !staffViewing\\) notFound\\(\\)/.test(page))miss.push('the Leadership page is not gated like a console page');if(!/readProgramOverview\\(/.test(page)||!/siteAdminHandoffPath\\(/.test(page))miss.push('the Leadership page does not edit the overview and open the website admin pages');if(!/siteAdminHandoffPath\\(/.test(r('components/sites/site-page.tsx'))||!/hs-nav-admin/.test((r('components/sites/site-chrome.tsx')+r('components/sites/house-header.tsx'))+r('components/sites/site-admin-bar.tsx')))miss.push('the website has no Admin link');if(!/withoutLeadershipPreferences\\((?:withoutWebsiteDrafts\\()?space\\.preferences\\)(?:\\))?/.test(r('lib/spaces/profile-modules.ts')))miss.push('the public profile projection still carries the overview');if(!/id: 'space\\.leadership'/.test(r('lib/admin/modules/space-modules.ts')))miss.push('the console menu has no Leadership row');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-862: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: The public profile projection must still strip leadership preferences when website draft stripping wraps the same preferences; all existing leadership route, menu and website handoff gates remain pinned. Re-pointed 2026-10-10: the house header markup moved from site-chrome.tsx into house-header.tsx (header handoff v5), so the probe reads both.
